values.message:
Hey River City team,

My daughter and I build websites for service businesses. Reading your reviews, people keep saying Anthony inspected the roof, answered every call and text, and came back after the job to make sure it was right. That's exactly what our method is built around, so we made you a website mockup:

https://rivercity.websitepreview.fluidframemarketing.com/

Note: It'll look a lot better with your logo and images on it! Lol

The preview opens with a recent case study, then explains the thinking behind every page and how it gets more people to find you and pick up the phone. For example, the tap-to-call links in your current site's footer dial 123-456-7890 instead of your number, and the only headline Google sees on your homepage is the word "Home".

By the way, our contact form system would have recognized this as a solicitation, and you wouldn't have even seen it.

How'd we do on your company vibe?

Josh
Fluid Frame Marketing
